response.answer: Large language models face limitations due to their "hall of mirrors" effect, lacking true indexical grounding. Peircean semiotics highlights the need for extended context and memory in AI for better alignment. Semiotic implications in AI involve mediated interactions and interdisciplinary impacts on safety and humanities.
